name: Cosy

keepsake.name: Hearth Bell
keepsake.line: A small brass bell. It rings when someone comes home.

theme: The living room as it is: warm wood, cream cushions. Shipped sprites; only the missing forms are new.
line: Warm wood and cream cushions. The room you started in.

name: Tidepool

keepsake.name: Pearl Shell
keepsake.line: A shell with a pearl still inside.

theme: Driftwood with scalloped shell edges; sea blue, sand, pearl white.
line: Driftwood and shell, from where the tide leaves things.

name: Moonlit

keepsake.name: Moon Pebble
keepsake.line: A smooth stone, cool at noon and warm at midnight.

theme: Night-reef blue lacquer, coral pink inlay, a soft moonstone knob; silver highlights.
line: Blue lacquer and coral, made for the reef at night.

name: Emberhold

keepsake.name: Forge Ember
keepsake.line: A coal that has never gone out.

theme: Forge-folk work: black charwood, riveted iron bands, amber glow; rust, coal, ember orange.
line: Black wood and riveted iron, made by the forge-folk.

name: Rootwood

keepsake.name: Acorn Seedling
keepsake.line: A seedling in a thimble, and growing.

theme: Woodfolk of the Hollow: living-wood curves, leaf carving, moss cushions; bark brown, moss and leaf greens.
line: Living wood and moss, shaped by the woodfolk of the Hollow.

name: Stormglass

keepsake.name: Spark Bead
keepsake.line: A glass bead with a small storm inside.

theme: Pale ash with a lightning scar, copper coils and glass beads; slate, copper, storm violet.
line: Pale ash, copper wire and glass beads, from the high ridge.

name: Fenkeeper

keepsake.name: Opal Drop
keepsake.line: A drop of opal on a reed string.

theme: The bog keeps things: dark oak with reed bindings, an oil-sheen opal; peat brown, murky teal, a violet glint.
line: Dark oak and tied reeds. The bog keeps things.

name: Ancient

keepsake.name: Gold Spiral
keepsake.line: A small spiral of gold leaf, worn thin by hands.

theme: Carved standing-stone slabs, spiral carvings, worn gold leaf; sandstone, faded gold, patina teal.
line: Carved stone and worn gold, older than the roads.

name: Lantern Night

keepsake.name: Paper Tassel
keepsake.line: A red tassel that still smells of festival evenings.

theme: Paper lanterns and bunting on painted wood; festival red, gold, cream.
line: Paper lanterns and bunting, for the longest evening of the year.

name: Quiet Verge

keepsake.name: Pocket Window
keepsake.line: A small stone window. Look in, and one warm star looks back.

theme: Dusk-violet stone edged in pale rim light, arches with a warm star inside, chips of stone that float; window dark, lilac, star gold.
line: Still stone and starlight, from the edge of the map.

name: Fairground

keepsake.name: Prize Rosette
keepsake.line: A pleated rosette with two ribbon tails. It says first prize.

theme: Striped awnings, bunting and prize ribbons on painted wood; red, cream, sky blue, sunny yellow.
line: Stripes, bunting and a prize for everyone, from the meadow.

name: Schoolhouse

keepsake.name: Teacher's Apple
keepsake.line: A polished red apple. Nobody has seen it eaten.

theme: Oak desks, a slate-green board, brass and chalk white, one red apple; slate green, warm oak, brass, chalk, apple red.
line: Oak desks, a chalk-dusted board and one very red apple.
